data_processing: To minimize variability arising from differences in sequencing depth, FASTQ files for all libraries (except LIB058979, LIB092645, and LIB083102) were downsampled to 20 million reads using Seqtk-1.3.
Raw RNA-seq reads were aligned to the GRCh38/GRCm39 reference genome using STAR v2.5.2b and checked for quality control using FastQC v0.11.5
Alignment files were indexed using SAMtools v1.3.154 and gene-level counts were obtained using featureCounts from the Subread v2.0.1 package
Assembly: GRCh38, GRCm39
Supplementary files format and content: tab-delimited text file includes raw counts for each sample
growth_protocol_ch1: NHDFs were maintained in low-glucose DMEM supplemented with 15% fetal bovine serum (FBS) and 1% Pen-strep (P/S) in humidified atmosphere with 5% CO2 and 5% O2, at 37C. iPSCs were maintained in mTESR+supplement in humidified atmosphre with 5% CO2 at 37C.
